caption: Reference-based detection and architecture in the exploratory 50-record screen. Panel A shows high/moderate curated-homology A-family, B-family and both-category genome counts; A and B overlap, and both-category detection does not require a unique A/B pair. Panel B classifies unique linked or separated A/B pairs, complex architectures and unresolved genomes. Separation requires more than four intervening CDS. Included-genome denominators are Mycobacterium, n=25 of 25 selected; Gordonia, n=25 of 25 selected. Counts retain the frozen evidence-tier caps and do not estimate population prevalence, diagnostic sensitivity or neighborhood conservation.
